blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
. Photographic evidence is becoming increasingly vulnerable to forms of alteration and fabrication that existing legal and technical workflows are not well equipped to evaluate. Surveillance frames, dashcam stills, and phone photographs
may be used to establish presence, sequence, causation, damage, or identity, yet contemporary generative systems allow non-experts to alter or fabricate such images through ordinary
prompt-based interfaces. Existing image-forensics benchmarks provide important resources for face manipulation, classical tampering, and general synthetic-image detection, but they are not organized around the forms of visual evidence submitted in courts, the localized edits that can change what an exhibit appears to prove, or the consumer-tool threat model now facing the justice system. We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a benchmark for evidentiary image authentication in court and justice-system contexts. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images, spanning surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Manipulations are organized into scene-condition edits, localized element edits, and full fabrications produced with contemporary generative systems. Each item is released with structured metadata covering source provenance, manipulation tier, subtype, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes, enabling controlled evaluation beyond aggregate binary detection. We also establish state-of-the-art baselines with publicly available image-manipulation detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The dataset, prompts, metadata manifest, code, and baseline evaluation scripts are released to support research on visual evidence authentication, information integrity, and trustworthy AI for the justice system.
blocks.zh:
。 。 。 照片证据越来越容易受到现有法律和技术工作流程不具备充分评价能力的改变和捏造形式的影响。 监视镜、短镜头和电话照片
可能用来确定存在、序列、因果关系、损害或身份,但当代的基因系统允许非专家通过普通方法改变或捏造这种图像。
即时界面。 现有的图像法基准为操纵脸部、古典篡改和一般合成图像探测提供了重要资源,但是这些基准不是围绕着法庭上提交的视觉证据形式、可以改变展览表面证据的局部编辑,或司法系统目前面临的消费者工具威胁模式。 我们介绍了用于检测AI-Maniped Images的CIFAR合成证据公司,这是法院和司法系统背景下证据图像认证的基准。 该套装包括1 505个照片,包括720个真实控制器和785个经操纵或伪造的图像、横跨监视、破损摄像头和消费者-照片。 操纵被组织成场景条件编辑,局部元素编辑,以及用当代基因系统产生的完全捏造. 每个项目发布时都有结构化元数据,涵盖源源,操纵级,子类型,生成器,即时模板,以及场景属性,使得控制评价超越聚合二进制检测. 我们还用公开的图像操纵探测器建立了最新的基线,表明目前的系统显示的误差剖面仍然有问题,难以作为证据使用。 发布数据集、提示、元数据表、代码和基线评价脚本,以支持关于视觉证据认证、信息完整性和司法系统可信AI的研究。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Courts increasingly receive photographs whose authenticity can no longer be taken for granted, including surveillance frames offered to show that a person was present at a location, dashcam stills used to reconstruct traffic incidents, and phone photographs submitted to document damage, injury, possession, or the condition of a scene. In each case, the image is not merely visual content, but evidence whose value depends on whether the depicted scene can be trusted, whether relevant details have been altered, and whether the image can be situated within a reliable chain of provenance. This paper addresses that problem as one of evidentiary image authentication, where the task is to evaluate whether photographic evidence is authentic, manipulated, or synthetic under conditions that resemble legal and institutional use.
blocks.zh: 法院收到的照片越来越多,其真实性已不可认为是理所当然的,包括显示某人在某一地点的监视架、用于重建交通事故的破烂相机静物、以及用于记录损坏、受伤、持有或现场状况的电话照片。 在每一种情况下,图像都不仅仅是视觉内容,而其价值取决于所描绘的场景能否被信任,相关细节是否被改变,以及图像能否位于可靠的来源链中. 本文将这一问题作为证据图像认证问题处理,其任务是评估照片证据在类似法律和体制使用的条件下是否真实、被操纵或被合成。

blocks.en: Photographs have never been self-authenticating records of reality, since courts have long required them to be connected to testimony, context, and procedure before they can function as evidence ( Grossman and Grimm, 2025 ) . Historical accounts of photographic admissibility show that courts have repeatedly had to reconcile the apparent objectivity of photographs with the possibility of staging, selection, distortion, and later digital alteration ( Mnookin, 1998 ) . The current challenge is therefore not that visual evidence has suddenly become uncertain, but that the practical conditions under which courts have managed that uncertainty have changed. Evidence that once required specialized skill to fabricate can now be altered or produced through widely available generative systems.
blocks.zh: 照片从来不是真实的自我认证记录,因为法院早就要求这些记录与证词、背景和程序相联系,然后才能作为证据发挥作用(Grossman and Grimm, 2025)。 关于照片可采性的历史叙述表明,法院一再必须调和照片的明显客观性与可能进行堆放、选择、歪曲和后来进行数字修改的可能性(Mnookin,1998年)。 因此,目前的挑战不是视觉证据突然变得不确定,而是法院管理这种不确定性的实际条件发生了变化。 曾经需要专门技能才能编织的证据现在可以通过广泛的基因系统加以改变或产生。

blocks.en: Fabricated and misleading evidence is not new, yet generative AI changes its cost, accessibility, and plausibility in ways that are directly relevant to evidentiary workflows. Earlier forms of photographic manipulation often required specialized tools, technical expertise, or substantial effort, whereas contemporary image-generation systems allow non-experts to produce plausible visual alterations through ordinary prompt-based interfaces. A litigant, witness, or third party can change scene conditions, insert or remove salient objects, or generate a plausible image from scratch without the expertise that previously constrained visual forgery. The same technological shift also creates a second evidentiary risk, since genuine evidence may be dismissed as fabricated precisely because fabrication itself has become credible. This is the dynamic Chesney and Citron ( Chesney and Citron, 2018 ) describe as the liar’s dividend, and it places pressure on courts and related institutions not only to detect false evidence, but also to preserve confidence in authentic evidence.
blocks.zh: 制造的和误导性的证据并不是新证据,但遗传性AI以与证据工作流程直接相关的方式改变其成本,可获取性和可信度. 早期的摄影操作往往需要专门的工具、技术专门知识或大量努力,而当代的图像生成系统则允许非专家通过普通的即时界面产生可信的视觉改变。 诉讼当事人、证人或第三方可以改变场景条件,插入或删除显著物体,或者在没有先前限制视觉伪造的专门知识的情况下从头产生一个可信的图像。 同样的技术转变也造成了第二个证据风险,因为真正的证据可能被否认为捏造,正因为捏造本身已变得可信。 这是充满活力的切斯尼和Citron(切斯尼和Citron,2018年)形容为骗子的红利,它不仅为法院和相关机构检测虚假证据,也为维护对真实证据的信心而施加压力.

blocks.en: Recent legal developments show that this concern has moved beyond speculation, as courts and judicial organizations are now confronting acknowledged and suspected AI-generated material, including fabricated legal authorities, synthetic media, and allegedly manipulated exhibits. In Mata v. Avianca ( Ryan and Garrett, 2023 ) , generative AI produced plausible but non-existent legal authorities that were submitted in litigation, illustrating how synthetic material can enter formal legal processes when verification fails. More directly for visual evidence, judicial and legal scholarship has begun to examine how courts should handle acknowledged and unacknowledged AI-generated evidence, while court-focused organizations have warned that synthetic evidence may affect public trust in judicial proceedings ( Heaton et al., 2026 ) . These developments make evidentiary image authentication a timely problem for legal institutions and for computational researchers working on information integrity, provenance, verification, and trustworthy decision support.
blocks.zh: 最近的法律发展显示,这种关切已经超越了猜测,因为法院和司法组织目前正在面对被承认和怀疑是AI生成的材料,包括捏造的法律当局、合成媒体和据称被操纵的展品。 在Mata诉Avianca案(Ryan和Garrett,2023年)中,基因特征AI产生了在诉讼中提交的可信但却不存在的法律权威,说明了在核查失败时合成材料如何进入正式法律程序。 对于视觉证据而言,司法和法律奖学金已开始审查法院应如何处理被承认和不被承认的AI生成的证据,而以法院为重点的组织则警告说,合成证据可能影响公众对司法程序的信任(Heaton等人,2026年)。 这些发展使得证据图像认证成为法律机构和从事信息完整性、来源、核查和可信决策支持的计算研究人员的及时问题。

blocks.en: The evidentiary risk is not limited to fully synthetic images, because in many legal settings the more consequential manipulation is a localized or contextual edit to an otherwise ordinary photograph. A person may be removed from a surveillance frame, a road sign or traffic signal may be changed in a dashcam still, or visible damage may be added to or removed from a phone photograph. Such edits can alter what an image appears to prove while preserving most of its visual content, which makes them difficult for lay observers ( Bray et al., 2023 ; Roca et al., 2025 ) and also difficult for detectors trained mainly on whole-image synthesis or face-centered deepfakes. For evidentiary authentication, the relevant question is therefore not simply whether an image was generated by AI, but whether verification systems can identify the forms of manipulation that change the informational and evidentiary meaning of a visual item.
blocks.zh: 证据风险并不限于完全合成的图像,因为在许多法律环境中,更间接的操纵是局部或背景编辑,以替代普通照片。 个人可以从监视架上取出,路标或交通信号仍可更换为破损摄像头,也可以在电话照片上增加或去除明显的损坏. 此类编辑可以改变图像看起来所证明的东西,同时保留其大部分视觉内容,这使得非专业观察者难以进行这种编辑(Bray等人,2023年;Roca等人,2025年),而且主要接受全图像合成或以面部为核心的深层假象培训的探测器也难以进行. 因此,对于证据认证而言,相关问题不仅仅是一个图像是否由AI生成,而是核查制度是否能够识别改变视觉物品的信息和证据含义的操纵形式.

blocks.en: Existing datasets do not adequately support this domain. Face-deepfake corpora have enabled important progress in synthetic-media detection, but they primarily address identity, expression, and facial manipulation rather than scene-level photographic evidence. General image-tampering datasets capture classical operations such as splicing, copy-move, and removal, but many predate prompt-driven consumer generation and do not reflect the artifacts, workflows, or editing patterns now available to non-experts. Other public resources provide authentic surveillance, driving, or consumer imagery, yet they do not provide controlled AI-generated manipulations, prompt metadata, generator metadata, or benchmark-ready labels. What is missing is a public resource for evaluating authentication systems on evidentiary image families, realistic manipulation types, consumer-interface generation, structured provenance, and detector behavior under conditions relevant to institutional use.
blocks.zh: 现有的数据集不能充分支持这个域. Face-deepfake corpora在合成媒体检测上取得了重要进展,但它们主要针对身份,表达,以及面部操纵,而不是场景层面的摄影证据. 一般的图像标记数据集可以捕捉到古典的操作,如斯皮克,复制移动,以及移除等,但许多前期的即时驱动的消费者生成,并不反映现在非专家可用的文物,工作流程,或编辑模式. 其他公共资源提供真实的监视、驱动或消费者图像,但它们不提供受控制的人工智能产生的操纵、即时元数据、生成器元数据或已准备好的基准标签。 缺少的是在机构使用相关条件下评价证据图像家族、现实操作类型、消费者界面生成、结构化出处和探测器行为的认证系统的公共资源。

blocks.en: We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a dataset and benchmark for evidentiary image authentication. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images. It spans three families of visual evidence, namely surveillance imagery, dashcam stills, and consumer photographs. Manipulations are organized into three tiers covering scene-condition changes, localized element edits, and complete fabrication. The manipulated images are produced using contemporary generative systems from multiple organizations, and each item is paired with metadata describing its source provenance, evidentiary family, manipulation tier, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了用于检测AI-Maniped Images的CIFAR合成证据公司,这是证据图像认证的数据集和基准. 该套装有1 505个照片,包括720个真实控制器和785个被操纵或伪造的图像。 它跨越三个视觉证据的家族,即监视图像、破片胶片和消费者照片。 操纵被组织成三层,涵盖场景条件的改变,局部元素的编辑,以及完整的捏造. 被操纵的图像是使用来自多个组织的当代基因系统制作的,每个项目都配有元数据,描述其来源、证据家族、操纵层、生成器、即时模板和场景属性。

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions. First, it releases a benchmark corpus of authentic and AI-manipulated photographic evidence across surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Second, it introduces a manipulation taxonomy grounded in evidentiary practice, with particular attention to localized edits that can alter the meaning of a visual exhibit while leaving most of the scene intact. Third, it provides a generation pipeline based on a realistic non-expert consumer-tool threat model. Fourth, it reports a zero-shot benchmark of off-the-shelf detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The corpus is available at https://github.com/UofT-CIFAR/Synthetic-Evidence-Image-Corpus , DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22015105 .
blocks.zh: 本文件提出了四项意见。 首先,它发布了一系列真实的、由人工智能操纵的摄影证据基准,这些证据跨越监视、破烂摄像头和消费者-摄影图像。 其次,它引入了基于证据实践的操纵分类法,尤其关注可以改变视觉展品含义的局部编辑,同时使大部分场景完好无损. 第三,它提供基于现实的非专家消费者工具威胁模型的一代管道。 第四,它报告了现成探测器的零射线基准,显示目前的系统显示的误差剖面仍然有问题,难以作为证据使用。 教程见https://github.com/UofT-CIFAR/Synthetic-Evience-Image-Corpus,DOI:10.5281/zenodo.22015105。

blocks.en: 2. Distinction from Existing Resources
blocks.zh: 2. 与现有资源的区别

blocks.en: Our corpus complements rather than replaces existing image-forensics benchmarks by targeting the authentication of photographic evidence under contemporary AI-enabled manipulation. Face-manipulation corpora such as FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, DFDC, ForgeryNet, and OpenForensics ( Rössler et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2020 ; Dolhansky et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2021 ; Le et al., 2021 ) primarily treat the face as the object of authentication, whereas our corpus treats the photograph as a visual claim about an event, location, object, or condition. General tampering benchmarks such as CASIA and the NIST Media Forensics Challenge datasets ( Dong et al., 2013 ; Guan et al., 2019 ) provide important coverage of splicing, copy-move, removal, and related operations, but largely reflect editing paradigms that predate consumer generative systems. Our corpus instead emphasizes prompt-driven generation and editing, including localized changes, scene-level modifications, and complete fabrication, capturing a contemporary non-expert threat model ( Corvi et al., 2022 ; Chandra et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, authentic-image resources such as VIRAT, UCF-Crime, BDD100K, and CASIA ( Oh et al., 2011 ; Sultani et al., 2019 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Dong et al., 2013 ) provide valuable source imagery but do not pair it with controlled generative edits, generation metadata, and manipulation labels designed for authentication analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们的教程补充而不是取代现有的图像法基准,在当代人工智能操纵下将摄影证据的认证作为目标。 FaceForensics+,Celeb-DF,DFDC,ForgeyNet,和OpenForensics等面部操纵蝎子(Rössler等人,2019年;Li等人,2020年;Dolhansky等人,2020年;He等人,2021年;Le等人,2021年)主要将面部作为认证对象,而我们的本体则将照片视为对某一事件,地点,物体,或条件的直观主张. CASIA和NIST媒体鉴证挑战数据集(Dong等人,2013年;Guan等人,2019年)等通用篡改基准,提供了斯普切,抄袭,移除,及相关操作的重要报道,但在很大程度上反映了消费者基因系统之前的编辑范式. 我们的教程则强调迅速生成和编辑,包括局部变化、场景水平的修改和完全捏造,捕捉当代非专家威胁模型(Corvi等人,2022年;Chandra等人,2025年)。 同样,VIRAT、UCF-Crime、BDD100K和CASIA等真实图像资源(Oh等人,2011年;Sultani等人,2019年;Yu等人,2020年;Dong等人,2013年)提供了宝贵的原始图像,但没有将其与用于认证分析的控制基因编辑、生成元数据和操纵标签配对。

blocks.en: Our corpus extends this ecosystem by organizing manipulated photographic evidence according to evidentiary family, manipulation tier and subtype, source dataset, generator, prompt, and scene attributes. This structure supports analysis beyond aggregate detection accuracy, allowing researchers to evaluate which evidentiary changes are detectable, which are missed, and which authentic images generate false positives. This focus addresses a gap identified by legal scholarship, which has increasingly emphasized the need for reliable authentication of AI-generated evidence and stronger mechanisms for addressing synthetic-media risks in litigation ( Chesney and Citron, 2018 ; Delfino, 2023 ; Dalal et al., 2025 ; Grimm et al., 2021 ; Grossman and Grimm, 2025 ) . While that literature establishes the institutional problem, it does not provide the empirical infrastructure needed to measure authentication performance on evidentiary photographs. Our corpus addresses this missing empirical layer without claiming that detection alone can resolve the legal problem; instead, it provides a benchmark for studying the reliability, failure modes, and limits of authentication systems in a setting aligned with evidentiary practice.
blocks.zh: 我们的本体扩展了这个生态系统 通过组织被操纵的摄影证据 根据证据家族,操纵层次和子类型,源数据集,生成器,即时,和场景属性。 这种结构支持超出聚合检测精度的分析,使研究人员能够评价哪些证据变化是可探测的,哪些被忽略,哪些真实的图像产生假阳性. 这一重点解决了法律奖学金所查明的一个缺口,它越来越强调需要可靠认证AI生成的证据,并加强解决诉讼中的合成媒体风险的机制(Chesney and Citron, 2018;Delfino, 2023;Dalal等人, 2025;Grimm等人, 2021;Grossman and Grimm, 2025)。 虽然文献确定了体制问题,但并没有提供衡量证据照片认证绩效所需的经验基础设施。 我们的委托书处理这一缺失的经验层,而不声称单靠检测就能解决法律问题;相反,它为在与证据做法相一致的环境下研究认证系统的可靠性、故障模式和限度提供了一个基准。

blocks.en: 3. Resource Design and Construction
blocks.zh: 3个 资源设计和建筑

Four image exemplars from the dataset. The top two images depict before and after of Tier-1 scene-condition edit adds snow to a dashcam frame. The bottom two images depict before and after of Tier-2 localized edit inserts a person into a surveillance frame.
blocks.zh: 图 1. 操纵实例。 顶部 : 第一级场景条件编辑将雪加入破片框. 底部:第二级本地化编辑将一个人插入监视框架. 数据集四个图像示例. Tier-1场景条件编辑前后描绘的顶部两幅图像将雪加入破碎的镜头框. Tier-2本地化编辑前后描绘的下两幅图像将一个人插入监视框架.

blocks.en: Our proposed corpus is designed for evidentiary image authentication rather than general synthetic-image detection. This setting requires a benchmark that represents the kinds of photographs submitted in legal and institutional contexts, includes manipulations that can change the evidentiary meaning of an image, reflects the consumer-tool threat model through which non-experts can now produce plausible edits, and provides metadata that supports controlled analysis beyond aggregate binary classification.
blocks.zh: 我们提出的程序是用来进行证据图像认证的,而不是一般的合成图像检测。 这种设定需要一个基准,代表在法律和体制背景下提交的各类照片,包括可以改变图像证据含义的操纵,反映消费者工具威胁模型,非专家现在可以通过这种模型进行可信的编辑,并提供元数据,支持超出集合二进制分类的可控分析.

blocks.en:
We operationalize these requirements along four axes. First , the corpus covers three evidentiary families: surveillance, dashcam, and consumer photographs. Second , it distinguishes three manipulation tiers: scene-condition
changes (T1), localized element edits (T2), and complete fabrication
(T3); Table 1 reports the full subtype breakdown by
family. Figure 1 shows representative T1 and T2
manipulations. Third , we use consumer-accessible generative systems from multiple organizations to reduce dependence on artifacts from a single provider. Fourth , each item includes metadata describing its source, evidentiary family, manipulation tier and subtype, generator, prompt, and scene attributes.
blocks.zh:
我们沿着四个轴线实施这些要求。 首先,调查令包括三个证据家庭:监视、破烂摄像机和消费者照片。 第二,它区分了三个操纵级别:场景条件
更改(T1)、局部元素编辑(T2)和完全制造
(T3);表1报告按类别分列的全部子类型细目。
家庭 家庭 图1显示代表性T1和T2
操纵。 第三,我们使用来自多个组织的消费者可获取的基因系统,以减少对单一供应商的文物的依赖。 第四,每个项目包括描述其来源、证据家族、操纵级和子类型、生成器、即时和场景属性的元数据。

blocks.en: For constructing the corpus, we first defined a fixed set of prompt templates, each tied to a family, tier, and subtype. The templates were written to model a non-expert using a consumer image generation interface. Each prompt requests a single scoped change, asks the model to preserve all other scene content, and aims to produce a plausible evidentiary image rather than an arbitrary edit. The final prompt set contains 27 templates spanning the three families and three tiers.
blocks.zh: 为了构建教程,我们首先定义了一套固定的即时模板,每个模板与一个家族,层次,和子类型相连. 这些模板是用来利用消费图像生成接口模拟非专家的。 每个提示请求单一范围修改,要求模型保存所有其他场景内容,并旨在产生一个可信的证据图像而不是任意编辑. 最终的提示集包含27个模板,覆盖三个家族和三个层次.

blocks.en: We constructed the source pool from public datasets matched to the three evidentiary families: VIRAT and UCF-Crime for surveillance, BDD100K for dashcam imagery, and CASIA v2.0 for consumer photographs ( Oh et al., 2011 ; Sultani et al., 2019 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Dong et al., 2013 ) . Tier 1 and Tier 2 manipulations use authentic source frames, while Tier 3 images are generated directly from prompts. Candidate frames were filtered using automatically extracted scene attributes to satisfy predefined quotas, and no source frame is reused.
blocks.zh: 我们从公共数据集建立了与三个证据家族匹配的源集合:用于监视的VIRAT和UCF-Crime,用于破伤风图像的BDD100K,以及用于消费者照片的CASIA v2.0(Oh等人,2011年;Sultani等人,2019年;Yu等人,2020年;Dong等人,2013年)。 第1级和第2级操纵使用正源帧,而第3级图像则直接由提示生成. 候选人帧被使用自动提取的场景属性进行过滤,以满足预先设定的配额,没有源帧被重新使用.

Table 1. Manipulated image corpus by evidentiary family, source
dataset, and manipulation tier.
blocks.zh:
表1. 按证据家庭分列的操纵成像仪,来源
数据集和操纵层。

blocks.en: Manipulated items were generated by applying the appropriate prompt template to the assigned source frame for Tier 1 and Tier 2, or from the prompt alone for Tier 3. Items were screened during generation and regenerated where the requested edit failed to appear or the scene was visibly degraded; this was not conducted as a formal annotation exercise, so we do not report inter-annotator agreement. The main corpus uses GPT Image 2, Gemini 3.1 with Nano Banana 2, and Firefly 5. GPT Image 2 and Gemini 3.1 were accessed through APIs, while Firefly 5 was accessed through its consumer interface. The corpus also includes a smaller Hero set produced through iterative human-in-the-loop refinement in Photoshop and ChatGPT. The main variants model ordinary single-pass manipulation, while the Hero set models a higher-effort adversary willing to manually refine an image.
blocks.zh: 操纵项目是通过将适当的即时模板应用于第一级和第二级指定源框架,或仅从第三级的即时生成。 当请求的编辑未出现或场景明显退化时,项目在生成期间进行了筛选和再生成;这并非作为正式的注释工作进行,因此我们不报告通知人之间的协议。 主体使用GPT图像2,双子座3.1与纳米香蕉2,以及萤火虫5. GPT图像2和双子座3.1通过API访问,而萤火虫5则通过它的消费者界面访问. 该套装还包括通过Photoshop和ChatGPT的迭代人机改进而制作的更小的英雄套装. 主要变体模式为普通单行道操纵,而英雄设定模式为高功率的对手,愿意手动改进一个图像.

blocks.en: 4. Dataset Content and Benchmarking
blocks.zh: 4个 数据集内容和基准制定

blocks.en: Table 2. Performance of off-the-shelf detectors.
blocks.zh: 图表 2. 现成探测器的性能。

blocks.en: To establish reference points for future work, we evaluate publicly available image-manipulation detectors on the corpus in a zero-shot setting. Each detector scores every image once using its released weights and default decision threshold, with no fine-tuning, and we report both threshold-free metrics (ROC-AUC, PR-AUC), which rank detectors independently of any operating point, and threshold-dependent metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, FPR) at each detector’s shipped default. The evaluation uses the DetectZoo framework ( Ebrahimi et al., 2026 ) and treats the task as binary authentication over all 1,505 items. The detectors span released synthetic-image detectors: a diffusion-reconstruction method ( d3 ), a CLIP-feature classifier ( univfd ), a diffusion-reconstruction contrastive detector ( drct ), and a CNN-based GAN-artifact detector ( cnnspot ).
blocks.zh: 为了建立未来工作的参考点,我们以零镜头的设定来评价关于炸弹的公开图像操纵探测器。 每个探测器一次使用其释放的权重和默认的决定阈值对每个图像进行评分,没有微调,我们同时报告无阈值的度量衡(ROC-AUC,PR-AUC),该度量衡独立于任何操作点的度量衡,以及阈值依赖的度量衡(精确度,精确度,回溯度,FPR)在每一个探测器的运出默认值上进行排序. 评价采用DetectZoo框架(Ebrahimi等人,2026年),并将这项任务作为所有1 505项的二进制认证。 探测器横跨释放的合成图像探测器:一种扩散-重建方法(d3),一种CLIP-特性分类器(univfd),一种扩散-重建对比探测器(drct),以及基于CNN的GAN-artifact探测器(cnnspot).

blocks.en: Across all systems, performance is low: the best detector, d3 , reaches only 0.674 ROC-AUC, and the rest sit near chance (Table 2 ). This is the central benchmarking result—off-the-shelf detectors, trained predominantly on fully synthesized GAN or diffusion imagery, transfer poorly to the localized edits and consumer-tool manipulations that characterize evidentiary content. Default operating points are also poorly aligned with evidentiary use: at its shipped threshold d3 catches fewer than half of all manipulations (47% recall) yet wrongly flags 22% of authentic images as manipulated, and falsely impugning genuine evidence is the more damaging error in court. A benchmark for evidentiary authentication must therefore report this error structure, not only aggregate accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在所有系统中,性能都很低:最佳探测器d3,只达到0.674 ROC-AUC,其余的几乎是偶然的(表2)。 这是核心基准结果——现成的探测器,主要是关于全面合成的GAN或扩散图像的培训,不适当地转移到作为证据内容特征的本地编辑和消费者工具操纵。 默认操作点也与证据使用不相符:在运出的阈值d3捕获不到所有操纵(47%召回)的一半,但错误地标出22%的真实图像为被操纵,而错误地指责真实证据是法院中更有害的错误。 因此,证据认证的基准必须报告这一错误结构,而不仅仅是总的准确性。

blocks.en: A breakdown of the strongest detector, d3 , illustrates the diagnostic value of the corpus design. Performance is uneven in ways that track evidentiary structure rather than overall difficulty. By family, dashcam imagery is markedly harder than surveillance or consumer photographs (AUC 0.55 versus 0.69 and 0.78). By generator, detectability varies sharply: items from one consumer model are far less detectable than another’s (per-generator recall ranging from 0.46 to 0.71), confirming that the corpus exposes cross-generator generalization gaps. The high-effort Hero set is the most revealing case: manually refined Photoshop edits receive extremely low manipulation scores, the lowest scoring at 0.04, and slip past the detector entirely, direct evidence that a motivated, hands-on adversary can defeat current systems. These findings position the corpus as a diagnostic benchmark for studying not just whether authentication systems succeed, but where they fail and which failure modes matter for evidentiary use.
blocks.zh: 对最强探测器d3的分解说明该装置设计的诊断价值。 在跟踪证据结构而不是总体困难方面,业绩参差不齐。 按家庭来看,破烂的图像明显比监控或消费者照片更难(AUC 0.55对0.69和0.78)。 按发生器计算,可探测性差异很大:一个消费模型中的物品远不如另一个模型的可探测性(每生成者召回从0.46到0.71不等),这证实了该物体暴露出跨生成者一般化的漏洞. 高级 英雄集是最有启发性的案例:手动精炼的Photoshop编辑得到的操纵分数极低,最低的分数为0.04,并完全滑过探测器,直接证据表明一个有动机的,亲手操作的对手可以击败当前的系统. 这些结论将本文书作为诊断基准,不仅用于研究认证系统是否成功,而且用于研究其失败之处,以及用于证据的失败模式。

blocks.en: 5. Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 5.五. 道德考虑

blocks.en:
The corpus derives from publicly released research datasets and is redistributed in accordance with source licenses. No imagery was collected from human participants and no material originates from real legal proceedings. As the work involves secondary use of data with no participant interaction, it did not require research ethics board review.
We draw only on the normal-activity subset of UCF-Crime; no individual appears in connection to a crime and no manipulation was designed to place an identifiable person at a real location or to attribute conduct to them.
Manipulations were produced using capabilities already available through consumer interfaces so we judge the uplift from release to be small relative to the benefit to detection research.
blocks.zh:
调查来源于公开公布的研究数据集,并按照来源许可证重新分配。 没有从人类参与者那里收集到任何图像,也没有从真正的法律诉讼中获得任何材料。 由于这项工作涉及二次使用没有参与者互动的数据,因此不需要研究道德委员会审查。
我们只利用UCF-Crime的正常活动子集;没有个人出现在犯罪中,也没有任何操纵行为旨在将可识别的人安置在真实地点或将行为归于他们。
操纵是利用通过消费者界面已经具备的能力产生的,因此我们判断,从释放到提升相对于探测研究的好处而言是很小的。

blocks.en: 6. Concluding Remarks
blocks.zh: 6个 结论意见

blocks.en: This paper introduces the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for evidentiary image authentication. The corpus enables diagnostic evaluation of contemporary AI manipulations across diverse photographic evidence, while our baselines show substantial weaknesses in current detectors, particularly for localized edits and authentic-image false positives. We release the corpus and benchmark infrastructure to support future research on reliable visual evidence authentication.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了CIFAR合成证据公司的证据图像认证。 这套程序可以对当代人工智能的操纵情况进行诊断性评估,包括各种摄影证据,而我们的基线显示,现有探测器存在重大弱点,特别是对局部编辑和真实图像假阳性而言。 我们公布证据和基准基础设施,以支持今后关于可靠视觉证据认证的研究。

blocks.en: GenAI Usage Disclosure
blocks.zh: GenAI 用户披露

blocks.en: The generative models central to this work (GPT Image 2 (OpenAI), Gemini 3.1 with Nano Banana 2 (Google), and Firefly 5 (Adobe)) were used to construct the manipulated portion of the corpus, as described in Section 3 . This use is the subject of the resource itself rather than an authoring aid, and all generated artifacts are released with the provenance metadata documented above.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的核心基因模型(GPT Image 2 (OpenAI),双子座3.1和Nano Banana 2 (Google),以及Firefly 5 (Adobe)),用于构筑第3节所述的被操纵的生物体部分。 这种使用是资源本身的主题,而不是一种写作援助,所有产生的文物都用上面记载的来源元数据发布.
